cohort: Studies included pregnant individuals whose maternal health outcomes were reported during or after birth.
finding: Higher preconception physical activity, particularly moderate-to-vigorous, is associated with a reduced risk of various adverse maternal health outcomes including gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, low infant birth weight, excessive pregnancy weight gain, and post-term delivery.
birth_weight: Outcome of interest was infant birth weight, specifically low birth weight.
gest_age: Outcome of interest was gestational age and duration of pregnancy.
